title: CategoryAssignment
description: Assigns a category and a productivity level to an app, a site (optionally a path) or a surface. Uncategorised activity is level 50.

level.title: CategoryLevel
level.description: 0 very distracting, 25 distracting, 50 neutral, 75 productive, 100 very productive (RescueTime -2..2 scaled).

categoryPath.title: CategoryPath
categoryPath.description: Slash-separated category slug, for example `development` or `video/short-form`. `uncategorised` and `browser-unknown` are reserved.
